name: Shield of Missile Attraction

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.curse: Ranged weapon attacks aimed at anyone within 10 feet of you are redirected at you instead.

summary: Resistance to damage from ranged weapon attacks. Cursed: ranged weapon attacks at creatures near you hit you instead.
text: Holding this Shield gives you Resistance to damage from Ranged weapon attacks. Curse: the Shield is cursed, and attuning to it curses you. Taking the Shield off doesn't end the curse; only Remove Curse, or comparable magic, targeting you lifts it. While cursed, you become the target of any attack made with a Ranged weapon against a creature within 10 feet of you.
